name: mutation-commit-staging
body: The commit-staging path that distinguishes writes from deletions. `apg.git.commit_files` (src/git.rs:605-650) stages writes with `index.add_path` (630-632) and deletes with `index.remove_path` (633-638), writes the index, compares trees, and creates a single commit — so a `node rm` mutation mixing writes (referencing files whose incident edges were stripped) and deletes (the removed node file) commits atomically. Its doc block (src/git.rs:594-599) records that the `.git/index.lock` write is already inside the caller's extended `apg.artifacts.acquire_spec_lock` scope. `apg.git.commit_file` (src/git.rs:652-655) delegates here. `apg.layers.write_through_with_deletes` (src/layers.rs:1905-2021) is the caller that builds the combined write+delete path set.
